description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling form controls and validation states, including focus styles, validation feedback, tooltips, and handling for checkboxes, radios, and file inputs. It is used to customize the appearance of form elements in a web application, particularly in Bootstrap-based styles.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Mixin to style the focus state of form controls, applying colors, background, border, outline, and optional shadows.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: Mixin to style validation feedback, tooltips, and related styles for form validation states (e.g., error, success), applying border colors, shadows, and display properties.
